findings.evidence: Lines 180/216/239 each perform `← SetLike.mem_coe` before the coe lemma; `Huber/Completion.lean:87` already ships `mem_completionRingOfDefinition_iff` (`@[simp]`, `(Iff.rfl)`) beside `coe_completionRingOfDefinition:81` for the same construction. Grep for `mem_topologicalClosure` in ./mathlib returns only `mapClusterPt_atTop_pow_iff_mem_topologicalClosure_zpowers`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem mem_topologicalClosure_map_coeRingHom_iff {G : Subring A} {x : Completion A} : x ∈ (G.map Completion.coeRingHom).topologicalClosure ↔ x ∈ closure (((↑) : A → Completion A) '' (G : Set A)) := (Iff.rfl)` and use it at lines 180, 216 and 239, matching the trio already present for the special case at `TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/Completion.lean:81-95`.
findings.issue: `coe_topologicalClosure_map_coeRingHom` is stated only at set level; there is no `mem_topologicalClosure_map_coeRingHom_iff`. Membership is not reachable by simp — `SetLike.mem_coe` rewrites set→SetLike, so `x ∈ (G.map coeRingHom).topologicalClosure` never unfolds — and every use must do `rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_topologicalClosure_map_coeRingHom]` by hand (lines 180, 216, 239). The PR description lists this lemma as added, but it is absent.

findings.evidence: `Huber/Completion.lean:77` defines the subring as that exact term; lines 94-95 re-prove openness via `isOpen_closure_image_coe (G := P.ringOfDefinition.toAddSubgroup)`, which is the body of the new `isOpen_topologicalClosure_map_coeRingHom` (Completion.lean:154-157).
findings.fix: Keep the named lemma but derive it: `UniformSpace.Completion.isOpen_topologicalClosure_map_coeRingHom P.isOpen_ringOfDefinition`.
findings.issue: `isOpen_completionRingOfDefinition` now duplicates the new general `isOpen_topologicalClosure_map_coeRingHom` (its subject `completionRingOfDefinition` is literally `(P.ringOfDefinition.map Completion.coeRingHom).topologicalClosure`, line 77), keeping two independently proved openness facts for the same object — the same duplication the PR removed at `Pair.lean:225`.

summary: The exposed surface is otherwise minimal and correctly annotated, but the `mem_*_iff` half of the characteristic API for the new closure object is missing (the PR description claims it exists; the file does not contain it), and the file itself works around its absence three times.
